digest.component_or_area: pytest logging capture and test harness
propositions: Negative caplog assertions (5 identified) pass vacuously when zero records are captured, masking complete loss of coverage while reporting green
Logger propagation set to False or level raised to WARNING globally and never restored poisons downstream test assertions across the process, causing order-dependent void assertions
pytest's caplog handler does not attach to loggers that become non-propagating after test setup begins, creating a silent window where assertions verify nothing
Autouse fixture guard detects propagation=False at test teardown and names the offending test as source; separately contains level changes via snapshot/restore to prevent cascade
Five negative assertions confirmed live and reaching during full default-selection run via instrumentation; all five fail when forbidden record is injected, proving none are vacuous
